title: Coast Guard Aids in Rescue of Two People After Sailboat Capsizes
description: A 29-foot Response Boat-Small II boatcrew from Coast Guard Station Cortez, Florida, re-right a 16-foot sailboat northeast of Anna Maria Island, Florida, Sunday, April 26, 2015. The boatcrew along with a Manatee County Sheriff's Office boatcrew rescued two people after their sailboat capsized. U.S. Coast Guard video
